assets.title: Side-Resting Deep-Bag Landing Net
assets.description: Original static low-poly landing net with a long straight wooden shaft, solid teal grip and sleeve, and a thick genuinely open oval frame. Twelve closed solid longitudinal cords and four closed cross-loop cords form a three-dimensional sparse mesh bag that narrows into one grounded gathering knot. The frame, shaft and grip lie in one tilted vertical plane in a fixed side-resting storage pose; the bag sags sideways to its gathered low end. Finite frame, grip and knot ground patches and measured volumetric joints connect every named component. Actual empty mouth and net windows are geometry, without transparent net textures. One editable prop, four constant solid PBR materials, metre scale, native Z up and ground-centre origin; no external dependencies. No fishing, catch retention, flexible-net behavior, loads, material stiffness, human fit, manufacture, regulation, animation or safety certification.
